name: hip_roof
description: Hip roof (四坡顶): all four sides slope up to a ridge line or point, built from stair rows with automatic step-in. V2: stair facing is geometrically derived per slope; corner cells carry outer_left/outer_right curve intent states (the mod may re-derive shape at placement).
when_to_use: Buildings whose style card says roof.type = hip, or square towers where a gable would leave awkward ends. origin = wall footprint corner, y = first layer above the top wall block. DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit facing/half/shape in the output JSON; change params and re-run instead (禁止手改方向状态).
